name: custom_axis/shared_time
description: Three vertically stacked plot panels, two ECG leads and a respiration trace, sharing one time axis. Judge only the plot panels; ignore tabs, headings, descriptions, and other surrounding UI.

checks.expectation: Three plot panels are stacked vertically with equal plot-area widths and aligned left and right edges. Panels and their content do not overlap each other. Do not evaluate tabs or other content outside the plots.

Time values from 0.0 to 10.0 appear as numbers below the bottom panel only, with the title Shared time (s) — pan or zoom here; there are no numbers below the top and middle panels. Numbers and tick marks along each panel's left vertical axis are expected and do not count as time labels. The vertical axes are Lead I (mV), Lead II (mV), and Respiration.

The top panel shows a green ECG trace and the middle panel a red ECG trace, each with about ten regular heartbeats with sharp QRS spikes; the spikes in both panels line up vertically in time. The bottom panel shows a smooth cyan respiration wave with about two and a half cycles.

Within the plots, axis titles and tick labels are readable and free of clear raster corruption. Fail only for concrete defects such as square pixel blocks, doubled glyphs, or severe stair-step edges that make plot text materially illegible. Do not compare plot text with headings, tabs, buttons, controls, or any text outside the plots. Normal antialiasing, small fonts, rotated text, and backend-specific softness are acceptable.
No panel is blank, corrupted, or reduced to a solid rectangle. Traces, grids, and axes remain visually distinguishable, and axis titles and tick labels are not cut off.
